contract: offline artifact / fault-injection corpus (fix-dv-19.07) for frontend-performance. Each case injects a fault, runs a state/output ORACLE (not a provider stub judging itself), records exit/trace/environment. DV-19: the counterexample FAILS pre-fix, PASSES post-fix, verified by STATE/OUTPUTS, release-tied.
release_tie: the fix ships in a tagged release; a counterexample that passes pre-fix is not a fix

environment.note: Lighthouse/CrUX stubs are inputs, never the oracle

cases.fault: only the three CWV declared field-measurable; FCP filed lab-only; INP 'passed by TBT'
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (FCP=lab-only; INP reported passed on TBT with no field data)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (FCP is field-measurable; CrUX-FCP+TBT+no-field-INP → FCP supported, INP unknown)

cases.fault: optimization heuristics applied as blanket rules without measurement
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (CSP allow-all for score / footer headings→p / last-two targets applied blind)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (each change gated on trace+scenarios, browser matrix, accessibility; no functional loss)
